blocks.x: After a weekend bout of some very not-fall-like weather here in our favorite city, residents across the boroughs are surely ready to get back to the regularly scheduled programming of cozy sweaters, colorful leaves, and pumpkin spice. Simply put: fall in NYC is about to get a whole lot more festive.

While we love an adventure—especially this time of year—you don’t actually need to book a weekend in the Hudson Valley, rent a car upstate, or trek out to a pumpkin patch hours from the city to get your fill of the season. NYC Parks is bringing plenty of classic fall traditions right to the five boroughs, and the best part? They’re all free.

From pumpkin patches and harvest celebrations to Halloween festivities, live entertainment, family-friendly activities, and even a little fall magic for the pups, there’s plenty to look forward to as the leaves start to change.

NYC Parks’ 2026 fall festival lineup runs all through October, with events happening across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. Here’s the full schedule of free fall festivals to add to your calendar this season.

Location: Williamsbridge Oval Recreation Center, Bronx

Whether you’re looking for a pumpkin–filled afternoon, a family-friendly Halloween celebration, a harvest festival, or simply another excuse to spend a crisp autumn day outside, there’s plenty happening right here in the city.

Best of all, you can enjoy the season without spending a fortune—or leaving the five boroughs. All that’s left to do is pick your weekend, grab your coziest sweater, and get ready for some classic fall fun.
